# Contract
Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/<that path>. That report file is the ONLY thing you may write inside the lane. All other lane files are READ-ONLY for you. Never run git or jj writes in the lane repo or the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin (no commit, add, stash, checkout, reset, push, fetch, jj mutation; read-only jj only with --ignore-working-copy; never write in the fleet repo), never touch sibling lanes, operator config (~/.omp, ~/.kimi-code contents) or host state.
Scratch ONLY under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kumitate-r42/seats/<YourName>/. Any code edit or gate run that writes happens in your OWN clone, made with GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE unset: env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git clone -q --no-hardlinks /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kumitate-r42/seats/<YourName>/lane && env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git -C /fast/scratch/hyaku/kumitate-r42/seats/<YourName>/lane checkout -q --detach b237e3f09c9559e130c7367bd2efa981c4ea516f. You may commit inside your own scratch clone; never push anywhere. Writers deliver their change as a patch file `git -C <clone> diff b237e3f09c9559e130c7367bd2efa981c4ea516f -- <paths> > /fast/scratch/hyaku/kumitate-r42/seats/<YourName>/<YourName>.patch` (apply-clean against b237e3f09c9559e130c7367bd2efa981c4ea516f) and name it in the report.
Quote the revision, the exact command and the observed output for every result; an unrun check is unverified, never passed. Mutation outcomes use the Stryker vocabulary: killed = at least one test failed while the mutant was active; survived = all passed; a crash, runtime error or timeout is NOT a kill. Any mutant or selftest run that may recurse (cite-check guard mutants recursed to 46 processes and 3.2 GB in 10 s in round 41) runs in its own process group under a timeout of at most 60 s and is killed by group; check leftovers are 0 afterwards.
No model param. You are a leaf: no spawns (an executor may spawn one read-only labrat probe for one falsifiable hypothesis), no agent://all, no background jobs left running. The only message target you may use is agent://KumitateR42 (the L1), and only for a blocker. Tooling: you may install or upgrade tools that help the task; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; official channels only; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. pacman guard: ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (no -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U, -R; no host service restarts); use uv tool / npx / an official binary in ~/.local/bin instead. No secrets: never read credential, token, oauth or server.token contents under ~/.kimi-code or ~/.omp (shape only).
Sourcing rule (binding): open sources by ordinary means only. Never use a headless browser or any other tool to pass a bot challenge, captcha or access control. Record a source you cannot open that way as unopened. A provider safety or policy refusal ends your item: report it as such and stop.
